categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: NFT Lending/Borrowing
categories.content: Individuals can use their NFTs as collateral to secure loans, or lend out their NFTs to others in exchange for interest, creating liquidity without the need to sell the NFTs themselves.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem
categories.content: Sun Pump Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via sunpump.meme.

categories.name: Poolz Finance Launchpad
categories.content: Poolz Finance Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: TRON Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the TRON network.

categories.name: SocialFi
categories.content: SocialFi combines social media and DeFi. It aims to bring a more decentralized and user-centric approach to social media platforms, allowing users to monetize their interactions and content directly.

categories.name: Prediction Markets
categories.content: A crypto prediction market is a marketplace where people can bet on the outcome of future events using crypto.

categories.name: Options
categories.content: Options refer to financial instruments that give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a cryptocurrency at a predetermined price, known as the strike price, before a specific date, known as the expiry date.

categories.name: Gambling (GambleFi)
categories.content: GambleFi refers to decentralized gambling platforms and tokens leveraging blockchain technology and smart contracts.

categories.name: Bitcoin Sidechains
categories.content: Bitcoin Sidechains are designed to enhance the Bitcoin blockchain's capacity by creating a new layer that improves transaction processing speed by handling transactions off the primary chain.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: Shooting Games
categories.content: Shooting games allow players to engage in combat by shooting enemies and objects. They can be presented in various perspectives including first-person or third-person views.

categories.name: Morpho Ecosystem
categories.content: Vault tokens within the Morpho Protocol.

categories.name: SideChain
categories.content: A sidechain is a separate blockchain that runs parallel to a main blockchain. It allows transactions and applications to operate independently to enhance scalability and functionality.

categories.name: Simulation Games
categories.content: Simulation game replicates real-world activities, offering players the opportunity to experience different skills or activities in a virtual environment.
